item.title: Are children born to Brits in Europe now required to have a UK passport?
item.description: Children who are born outside the UK to at least one British parent are, in many cases, automatically entitled to British citizenship - but changes to the UK travel rules means that these children may now be required to get a UK passport to travel to Britain.

item.title: Swedish Centre Party 'will never accept a government including the Left Party'
item.description: The Centre Party has announced its chief aim is for Sweden to have a new government after the next election, but one that does not include the Left Party or the far-right Sweden Democrats.

item.description: Knowing where to put the verb in Swedish sentences is a common issue for Swedish learners, so don’t feel disheartened if you often make this kind of mistake. Hopefully this guide will help.

item.title: Swedish finance minister willing to investigate joining euro after election
item.description: Sweden's finance minister Elisabeth Svantesson has said that she wants to investigate the possibility of joining the euro if her party is in government after the election in September.
